required.name: loghost
required.description:
Host that runs the SSI.
 If SSI runs on a different computer, this field should hold the IP address of the computer

required.name: logport
required.description:
Port to connect to SSI.
 This field holds the SSI listening port.

required.name: logvar
required.description: A VSM Sceneflow var that gets messages from SSI

optional.name: broadcast
optional.description: Broadcast messages in local network. Set to "true" for StudyMaster remote control

optional.name: broadcastport
optional.description: Port on which messages are broadcasted.

optional.name: listentostudymaster
optional.description: Listen to StudyMaster input. Set to "true" for StudyMaster remote control

optional.name: studymasterport
optional.description: Port on which StudyMaster receives messages.
